about: Where the four load cells sit under the deck, and which one we expect on each amplifier input.
Positions are measured on the top surface from the deck's FRONT-LEFT corner (seen from above,
facing forward on the belt): x_m to the right, y_m toward the back, in metres, to the centre
of each load cell. (The positions are still rough: measure them.)
WIRING: entry N is amplifier input N (M12 connectors 1-4 on the Michigan Scientific SGA12),
so signals NX, NY, NZ come out on wire bundle N. 'serial' is the TR3D-A-3K serial of the cell
we expect there. A corner belongs to its serial: if loadcell_cal.py finds the serials on other
inputs (from their resting volts), each input takes its serial's corner.
SCALE: newtons per volt and crosstalk come from each serial's calibration sheet, typed into
loadcell_cal.SHEETS. To override them for one cell, add "newtons_per_volt": {"X": .., "Y": ..,
"Z": ..} and/or "crosstalk": [[..],[..],[..]] to its entry. "flip": ["X"] makes that axis
negative (the GUI wants a load pressing down on the deck to be +Z).
